item.title: Trump explains to Axios why he endorsed Netanyahu's reelection
item.description: President Trump endorsed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Sunday, nine days before Israel's Oct. 27 elections, and explained his reasoning to Axios.

item.title: Trump once questioned Obama's citizenship; now Obama defends Ilhan Omar.
item.description: Former President Barack Obama strongly condemned the Trump administration's legal pursuit of Democratic Rep. Ilhan Omar over suspicions.

item.title: Wright calls Trump's diesel deal a peace incentive; Rubio says Russia would sell anyway.
item.description: President Trump's top aides gave differing explanations this weekend of his Russian diesel deal amid bipartisan criticism.

item.title: Zelensky speaks with Witkoff and Kushner amid U.S.-Ukraine crisis
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky spoke Sunday with President Trump's envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner about the crisis between the countries.
